Searching for podcast episodes beyond subscriptions - Feature request - AntennaPod Forum AntennaPod Forum Searching for podcast episodes beyond subscriptions Feature request trance June 11, 2021, 6:01pm 1 Hey folks.
AntennaPod uses the iTunes or PodcastIndex database and Api to search.
tonytamsf June 15, 2021, 11:35pm 4 Good news, podcastindex.org has a search by person api.
This api would solve your use case of searching for a guest.

https://podcastindex-org.github.io/docs-api/#get-/search/byterm I could imagine implementing this 2 ways When we see a search we will do 2 searches, one by podcast keyword and one by person and merge them.
This might be confusing, it maybe better to call the person api only when there are no results from search for podcast by keyword.
Either 1 or 2, this will bring up the feature of listening to episodes without subscribing to a podcast.

evidence.title: AntennaPod hits 150,000 monthly active users
evidence.snippet: February 12, 2024 - AntennaPod, an open-source podcast app for Android, has hit 150,000 monthly active users on Google Play. As can be seen above, the app saw significant growth on Sep 26, the day that it was announced Google Podcasts is to close. Much of this growth has been in the US, according to data seen by Podnews. “While we undoubtedly have a small market share, we’re proud of this increase,” says @keunes, one of the volunteer project maintainers.
